user.title: Sublunary
user.description: The realm of change beneath the Moon. Every void-of-course definition gets its own binary sensor; enable or disable them from the entity settings.

data_description.tick_minutes: How often contact depth updates between discrete events.
data_description.birth_timezone: The zone where you were born, so historical daylight saving is handled.
data_description.birth_location: Filled in by the birth place lookup, or pick it on the map.
data_description.house_system: Placidus falls back to Porphyry above about 66° latitude.
data_description.birth_place: Type a city, like "Chicago" or "Springfield, IL", to look it up offline. It fills in the map and the time zone. Or leave it empty and use the map.
data_description.birth_year: Optional. With a birth place, Sublunary tracks which of your natal houses the Moon is in. Stored only in your Home Assistant.
data_description.birth_time: As local clock time where you were born; the time zone handles daylight saving.

place.title: Which birth place?
place.description: Pick the city you were born in. Cities of 5,000 people or more, from GeoNames.

error.invalid_birth: That isn't a real date. Check the month and day.
error.birth_location_required: Pick a birth place on the map to use a birth time.
error.place_not_found: No city by that name. Check the spelling, or pick the place on the map.
error.birth_incomplete: Fill in the year, month, day and time of birth, or leave all four empty.
